title: AuthSession
description: A login session of the current user (one refresh-token family), as listed by GET /users/@me/sessions. Not to be confused with the gateway Session of SESSIONS_REPLACE.

id.description: Session ID; the `sid` claim of its access tokens.

client.description: The client that opened the session, derived from its User-Agent (for example `Discordy Desktop`, `Firefox`).

os.description: Operating system derived from the User-Agent (for example `Windows`), or `Unknown`.

device_name.description: Name of the registered end-to-end encrypted device bound to the session, if any.

location.description: Approximate location (an ISO 3166-1 country code from the edge), or null when the edge does not provide one.

last_used_at.description: When the session last logged in or refreshed its tokens.

current.description: Whether this is the session making the request.
